note: Published issuer/SEC figures available before retrospectively chosen entries. NOT point-in-time forecasts, net-cash models, cash runway or audited stock price. All observations remain research-only until independent reconciliation.

facts.method: Quarterly operating expenses from November 2022 issuer report, approximate.

facts.method: Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities as of September 30, 2022, per November 3 issuer release.

facts.method: Cash used in operations for nine months ended September 30, 2022.

facts.method: Net loan facility proceeds during nine months ended September 30, 2022.

facts.method: March 31 cash and cash equivalents from issuer's May 9 results.

facts.method: Quarter ended March 31, 2024 net loss.

facts.method: Potential strategic financing facility mentioned by issuer subject to funding availability.

facts.method: Issuer rounded March 31 cash and marketable securities total including restricted cash and long-term securities.

facts.method: March 2024 underwritten public stock and pre-funded warrant offering net proceeds, included in reported March 31 cash.

facts.method: Quarter ended March 31, 2024 net loss.

facts.method: SEC Q3 2023 filing, 62.055 million cash and 170.296 million marketable securities (fair value table), summed.

facts.method: Company audited year-end consolidated balance sheet summary published March 10, 2025.

facts.method: New term loan net proceeds during Q1 2024, per issuer.
